mapper.select: SELECT ud.id, ud.dept_id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName, d.type AS deptType, ud.is_primary AS isPrimary, ud.create_op AS createOp, ud.create_time AS createTime, ud.modify_op AS modifyOp, ud.modify_time AS modifyTime FROM sys_user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON ud.dept_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE ud.deleted = 0 AND ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.create_time ASC
